accepted_reseed_failure.reason: Expected install-key invalidation: correct build, zero old-seed hits, new publication uploaded. Candidate and runtime artifacts are pinned to this pilot.

method: Reuse original Datadog worktree/output/scratch paths. Validate historical steady seed and the optimized pilot exact zero-hit failure. Hardlink only the new local publication closure and pilot CAS; authenticate the sole new source receipt and replay its original CommitRequest into a new catalog to assign valid sequence 1. Stabilize minimal then toplevel with the same copied local cache/catalog; both must hit, final pass must write zero. Freeze after stabilization. Fresh JVM and synchronous clean before every build; empty graph/outputs/action cache checked. Same remote action cache/BES; no disk cache. Identical frozen local seed and remote catalog. Fresh staging cache each measured run. Remote backend restart and one full read/idempotent-commit warmup excluded from timers; new commit writes not warmed. Selected arms rotate and policy order alternates across repeats. Candidate, vanilla and worker runtime must match the reseed pilot. Local writes must be zero; remote uncached cache-only writes are recorded, not capped. Metadata proxy counts gRPC wire bytes separately from action-cache gRPC logs; no additional pilot is run.

argv:
import importlib.util
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('warmup', sys.argv[1])
warmup = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(warmup)
metadata = (('build.bazel.remote.execution.v2.requestmetadata-bin',
             warmup.blob(1, warmup.blob(1, b'skycache-benchmark-reseed'))
             + warmup.blob(2, b'new-publication-registration')
             + warmup.blob(3, uuid.uuid4().hex.encode('ascii'))),)
with warmup.grpc.insecure_channel(sys.argv[2]) as channel:
    warmup.grpc.channel_ready_future(channel).result(timeout=30)
    commit = channel.unary_unary('/build.bazel.skycache.v1.SkyCacheCatalog/CommitPublication')
    response = commit(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_bytes(), metadata=metadata, timeout=90)
    Path(sys.argv[4]).write_bytes(response)
